title: ReviewBench agent manifest
description: Describes how to reach a vendor's agent. Declares the shape of any credentials it needs, never their values.

name.description: Stable identifier, used as the producer on every finding. Lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash.

display_name.description: How the reviewer is named on the leaderboard.

provider.description: The company or individual behind the reviewer. Optional: when omitted, the API stores the display_name here.

image.description: Container image on the GitHub Container Registry, pinned by digest so a run is reproducible and the bytes cannot change under us: ghcr.io/<owner>/<name>@sha256:<64 hex>.

configuration.description: Labels distinguishing this configuration from others you test, such as model or effort tier.

key.description: Becomes the environment variable RB_CONFIG_<KEY> inside the container, upper-cased. Letters, digits, underscore, dash; starts with a letter.

secrets.description: The SHAPE of the credentials your agent needs. Values are never placed here; they are collected separately and stored write-only.

env.description: Environment variable names your agent reads.

files.description: Absolute paths your agent expects a credential file at.

egress.description: Hosts your agent contacts besides the host of model_api_url, which is allowed for you. Anything else is blocked during a run. Give model_api_url, at least one host here, or both.

model_api_url.description: The model API your agent calls, for example https://api.openai.com/v1 or https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/v1. It reaches your container as RB_MODEL_BASE_URL, and its host is added to egress, so the endpoint is set in one place.

pr_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds your agent needs for one pull request. Ask for more only if you need it; longer runs are more likely to be cut short.

contacts.description: GitHub usernames allowed to act for this agent: start runs, publish, rotate credentials. Everything a vendor does later is checked against this list.

notes.description: Anything we should know when running your agent.

image_visibility.description: public: the runner pulls anonymously. private: the runner pulls with the GHCR_PULL_TOKEN the vendor stores with its credentials (a GitHub token with read:packages).
